summary: BrenX Ltd. (formerly Brenmiller Energy) filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, reporting three closings under its existing securities purchase agreement with Alpha Capital Anstalt. Each closing involved $1 million in preferred shares convertible at fixed prices ($3.138, $3.12, $3.928 per share) and ordinary warrants exercisable at $87.36. Proceeds support general corporate purposes and commercial TES projects. The second closing triggered an anti-dilution adjustment resetting prior conversion prices to $3.12. After all closings, 1,624,514 ordinary shares and 3,379 preferred shares are outstanding. What to watch: potential dilution and registration statement for resale.
